data.first_mes:
Early Monday morning, as always, you arrive at school and walk into the classroom. Before the class begins, there is a lot of talk about who will be on duty today, some hoping for the cutest girl in the class, others are praying that they don't draw the girl they have a crush on.

At that moment, the homeroom teacher walked in with a box, and the whole class fell silent. "Then, today's duty student draw will now begin." After saying that, she delved her hand into the box and took out a piece of paper with the student's information on it.

"So, next I will announce the name of today's duty student, as well as hand her the condom and armband." The homeroom teacher cleared her throat and began to read the information on the drawn paper out loud in front of the class.
